budget_per_classifier_per_context.stage_A_design: complete 9 selectors x 6 counts x 3 classifier-specific profiles; count is never bound to one profile
budget_per_classifier_per_context.stage_B_design: for EVERY classifier, its two best training-only selectors x six counts x two pre-generated parameter draws; no classifier discarded
budget_per_classifier_per_context.stage_C_design: best training-only selector/parameters from A+B crossed with all six counts; part of formal search and matched count curve
budget_per_classifier_per_context.duplicate_policy: reuse identical recipe evaluations; report attempts and unique/effective fits separately

selection_rule: deterministic hash ties, no classifier-order preference
calibration: fixed sigmoid C=1 on training-only crossfitted raw margins; feature selection/scaling refitted in each calibration fit fold
